sql:
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' AND UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE (SEX = 'M' AND UA <= 8.0) OR (SEX = 'F' AND UA <= 6.5)
